turns.text: My daughter starts secondary school in September and we're working out how she'll get there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The school bus picks up at the end of our road, but it leaves really early, at ten past seven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She could take the public bus with her friends, it's later but involves one change in town.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I drop her at the train station on my way to work, and she takes one stop.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For the first term, the school bus takes the pressure off everyone. Once she's settled and confident, the public bus with her friends is a nice step towards independence.
